command:
cd /CLONE-spec.slot-3 && git commit -qam "Show the contact search field with its accessibility identifier

Replace the system .searchable field, which carries no identifier, with a
visible Search text field at the top of the contact list bound to the same
searchTextChanged action, so contact search stays reachable by id.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git rev-parse --short HEAD && /HARNESS/plugin/bin/swiftgate qa run --plan spec --after send-flow --before-merge --fix --json 2>&1 | tail -60

cd /CLONE-spec; SG="/HARNESS/plugin/bin/swiftgate"; S=f43f6be3-b6fa-45df-8258-3a3f1f577f4c; O=/CLONE/.git/swift-harness/plans/spec/out
"$SG" qa run --plan spec --after send-flow --before-merge --json > $O/qa-sf.json; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('$O/qa-sf.json'))
print(d.get('verdict'),d.get('runID'),d.get('message'))
for r in d.get('rows',[]): print(r.get('requirement'),r.get('result'),r.get('reusedFrom'))"
"$SG" build merge spec send-flow --session $S --json | grep -E '"reason"|"status"|"message"|fixWorktree|fixBranch'
